newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes Benz - talks with Porsche collapse.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes Benz - talks with Porsche collapse.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG said Friday that talks with sports car maker Dr.Ing.h.c.F Porsche AG to jointly produce an upscale sport utility vehicle had broken down.
A Mercedes spokesman said the talks had broken down because of worries the proposed vehicle would not be profitable enough.
The two automakers had been looking for a way to cooperate on producing a top-end version of the Mercedes M-Class vehicle since last summer.
The M-Class, which is to be made in the United States, is set to roll off assembly lines later this year.
Porsche had been looking for a partner to develop such a car to help it diversify from its dependence on the sports car market.
